durationDays.label: Validity (days)
durationDays.hint: Number of consecutive days, from 1 to 366.
durationDays.error: Enter a number of days from 1 to 366.

price.hint: E.g. 25 or 25.50. A price of 0 means a free permit.

waters.hint: The permit covers the selected waters of the organization.

offer.empty: This water has no permits on sale yet.

buy.unavailable: This permit type is no longer on sale for this water.
buy.backToCatalog: Back to the map of waters

validFrom.label: Start date
validFrom.errorPast: The start date cannot be earlier than today.

discount.JUNIOR: Reduced permit for people who are under {{age}} on the start date.
discount.SENIOR: Reduced permit for people who are {{age}} or older on the start date.

buy.paymentNote: The permit will be valid once the payment operator confirms the payment.

mine.title: My permits
mine.toCatalog: Find a water on the map
mine.externalLead: Add a permit bought from a fishery operator outside the platform here to record catches in the register.

detail.title: Permit
detail.revokedOn: Permit revoked by the organization on {{date}}
detail.revokedHint: It no longer entitles you to fish or to record catches. For a refund, contact {{organization}}.

qr.showFullscreen: Show the code in full screen
qr.fullscreenTitle: Show the code to the inspector
qr.brightness: Increase the screen brightness so the code scans more easily.

device.notice: No network — permits saved on this device, as of the last connection.
device.missing: This permit is not on the device. Open it once you are connected to the network.

list.title: External permits
list.lead: Permits bought outside the platform, e.g. from the fishery operator of a water not on the platform. You can record catches on them in the register and we will check them against the general regulations.
list.empty: You have no external permits yet.

new.title: New external permit
new.lead: Copy the details from the permit and choose the waters where it is valid. A photo or scan will be useful during an inspection.

issuer.label: Issued by
issuer.hint: Fishery operator or shop, e.g. "Gospodarstwo Rybackie Wąsosze".

dates.ORDER: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
dates.TOO_LONG: A permit can be valid for at most 366 days.
dates.TOO_LATE: A permit can start at most 365 days from now — check the year.

waters.search: Search for a water by name
waters.noResults: No water with this name was found.
waters.narrow: There are more results — enter a more precise name.
waters.full: {{max}} waters are already selected — remove one to add another.

photo.label: Photo or scan of the permit (optional)
photo.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB.
photo.type: Choose a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF file.
photo.tooBig: The file is larger than 5 MB.

detail.title: External permit
detail.photoNotAdded: The permit was saved, but the photo was not added. Try again below.
detail.rulesNote: Catches on this permit are checked against the general regulations; you know the water's rules from its fishery operator.
detail.editLead: Catches already recorded will not be checked again.

photo.title: Permit photo
photo.hasImage: A photo of the permit has been added.
photo.hasPdf: A scan of the permit (PDF) has been added.

register.title: Catch register for the fishery operator
register.lead: A PDF with the fish kept during the season — date, water, species, quantity, length and weight. Catches that break the rules are marked. Send it to the fishery operator, just like a paper register.

delete.confirm: Delete the permit "{{name}}"? A permit with recorded catches cannot be deleted.
delete.waiting: Catches recorded on this permit are waiting to be sent on this device. Send them to the register first — a permit with catches cannot be deleted.

orgList.title: Sold permits
orgList.revokeHint: Revocation cannot be undone: the permit is no longer valid in inspections or in the catch register. Any refund is made outside the platform — note it in the reason.
